build_inlinepatterns_registry: build a registry of inline pattern processors for markdown parsing with backtick, link, image, and emphasis support
create_inlineprocessor_subclass: create a custom InlineProcessor subclass that overrides handleMatch to return an ElementTree element and match boundaries
create_linkinlineprocessor: create a LinkInlineProcessor to parse inline markdown links with nested brackets and optional titles
create_astteriskprocessor: create an AsteriskProcessor to parse nested emphasis and strong patterns using asterisk delimiters
create_automailinlineprocessor: create an AutomailInlineProcessor to parse auto-mail links and obfuscate email addresses with HTML entities
